title: refactor(rest): move registerApprovalsEndpoints into approvals-routes.ts, with one registrar list (#23050 slice 3)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 3 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1-6) with slice 2's getter refinement (`6189011700`): the body of `RestServer#registerApprovalsEndpoints` (the approval request list and read, the `approve` / `reject` decisions, `recall`, the `revise` / `resubmit` flow moves, the `reassign` / `remind` / `request-info` / `comment` thread interactions and the audit trail; 12 routes from 7 registration sites) moves, unedited, to the new module `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`. It is move-only. Routes, the route ledgers and the published `dist/*.d.ts` are byte-identical, and every reader whose reading included a moved line now reads it where it is.

The slice also adds the one list the seat ruled for (`6189011700`, answering PR #23642's open question 2): `packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts`, the files `RestServer`'s registrars live in. The whole-file readers of `rest-server.ts` import it, keep their sums over it, and pin its length. It is not a gate.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 12,520 to 12,070 lines. The card stays open for the later slices.

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads**, from an AST walk of the method at base `c7dd48ab4` (line numbers there): fields `routeManager` :1960 and `approvalsServiceProvider` :2031; methods `enforceAuth` :2406 and `resolveExecCtx` :2806. That is 4 members (7 reads each of `routeManager`, `enforceAuth` and `resolveExecCtx`, 2 of `approvalsServiceProvider`). The body has no bare `this` and no element access on `this`.

**Module-level names the body reads:** `APPROVAL_REQUEST_LIST_PARAMS`, `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` and `readDeclaredQueryNumber`, all three already exported from `rest-server.ts`; and `strandedDecisionDetails` and `sendError` (as `sendEnvelopeError`) from `@objectstack/types`, `classifiedRefusalAnswer`, `nestedRefusalEnvelope`, `sandboxFaultAnswer` and `handleRouteError` from `./error-response.js`, `logError` from `./log.js`, `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` and `refuseUnknownQueryParams` from their modules. **No export was added** anywhere. `strandedDecisionDetails` was used only by the moved body, so its import and its comment move with it, and `rest-server.ts` keeps a two-line pointer comment where it was.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B):** the class keeps `private registerApprovalsEndpoints(basePath)` with its name, docblock and position. Its body is now one `ApprovalsRouteHost` literal and `registerApprovalsEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Each interface member is typed as the class member (an indexed access on `RestServer`). Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeManager` | registration only (every `register` call, the three route factories' included, since each factory runs during registration) | its one swap (`registerMetadataEndpoints`) wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |
| `approvalsServiceProvider` | **request time** (`resolveService`, from every handler) | not by the class (constructor only), but the field is not `readonly` | **getter** |

The getter is measured, not argued. A one-off test boots a source `RestServer` with no provider, drives `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id`, then assigns `approvalsServiceProvider` on the instance AFTER `registerRoutes()` and drives it again:
- this head: `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, then `200 {"id":"r1","status":"pending"}`. The door reads the live field, as it did when it read `this.approvalsServiceProvider` on the server.
- by-value ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the getter replaced by `approvalsServiceProvider: this.approvalsServiceProvider,`; anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, read back on disk inside the run): `501`, then `501` again. The value shape would freeze the field at registration. Restored by the tool and by a trap: blob `da10d3841b4d` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, the one-off test file deleted.

## The registrar list

`packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts` exports `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES` (`rest-server.ts`, `data-action-routes.ts`, `batch-routes.ts`, `approvals-routes.ts`), its element type, and the repo-relative directory for readers outside the package. It is test-side only: nothing in `src/index.ts` reaches it, so tsup never emits it (measured: `dist/` names it nowhere), the same placement as `src/http-request-test-builder.ts`.

The five zero-contribution whole-file readers now read every file on it. Each keeps its sum and pins the length (4). The moved body contributes zero to each, measured per file with each reader's own rule at base and head:

| reader | reads | sum over the list | what pins it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts` | numeric coercions | 9 = 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 | new case: length 4, files in list order, 9 sites; the ledger is unchanged |
| `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` | `query:` slots | 4 = 1 + 3 + 0 + 0 | per-file floors keyed by the list's own type; new control: length 4, floor keys equal the list, census order, sum 4 |
| `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` | draft switches | 8 = 8 + 0 + 0 + 0 | new case: length 4, files in list order, 8 sites; the node helpers now read each node's own source file; the ledger is unchanged |
| `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` | stacked docblocks, per-module floors | floors 4 + 3 + 3 = 10 over the three modules | floors keyed by the list's type; new case: length 4, floor keys equal the list less `rest-server.ts`, sum 10 |
| dogfood realtime tripwires (`authz-conformance.test.ts`) | transport mechanics and route paths | 0 hits over the four files | the two `rest-server.ts` probes gain `alsoReads` (every other list file); `probeSource` reads them with `file`; the ZERO case pins length 4 and that each probe's text is exactly the four files joined |

The tripwire probes' `file` stays `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` and their keys are unchanged, so the probe-table census (`entries 25 / files 20 / keys 33`) and the matrix header's count do not move.

Three readers that slices 1 and 2 extended by hand, because the moved lines contributed to them, now read the list too rather than gaining a fourth name: `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts`, the two `ui-view-route-*.measurement.test.ts` files and the dogfood blind-spot census's `rest-server.ts` row (sums below).

## Proof of move-only

- **`.d.ts`**: `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are byte-identical to base `c7dd48ab4`, sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9` for all four files (`cmp` silent), rebuilt at the final head `9305039c6`. The ESM and CJS bundles load, 39 exports each, one sorted export-name list (sha256 `b3246be6a171...` base and head). `packages/rest/src/index.ts` is untouched. The bundle JS bytes differ, because code moved within it.
- **Routes** (base `c7dd48ab4`, head `9305039c6`): a source `RestServer` on a recording mock server, with a protocol that implements every member, dumped under three configs. `getRoutes()` (functions recorded as arity), the ordered server registration calls, and a whitespace-free source hash of every handler are byte-identical base vs head, 9 dumps of 9:
  - default: routes `ee3a764e19bd...ecde0d`, calls `3c5754404a85...6319dd`, handler sources `236986995419...40ef05` (75 routes, 12 approvals)
  - scoped-optional: `eb7a21beb5de...56d66a` / `64c05f47329e...6b5f00` / `6e7abd35ba0c...70ab2c` (150 routes, 24 approvals)
  - scoped-required: `d6d0e5068384...9263e6` / `8ede6c93247d...a94b02e` / `54656e8e8abf...ac66c424` (75 routes, 12 approvals)
- **Route ledgers**: `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` and `packages/rest/src/index.ts` are untouched.
- **Moved body**: base `rest-server.ts` lines 11887-12347 (`git show c7dd48ab4:packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | sed -n 11887,12347p`), with one 4-space indent level removed (`sed 's/^    //'`), against `approvals-routes.ts` lines 87-547: `diff` exits 0 and prints nothing (461 lines). The body holds no multi-line string or template literal, so re-indenting changes no runtime string.
- **Moved-line accounting** (`git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change c7dd48ab4 HEAD` over the two files): 464 deleted and 471 added lines are detected as moved. `rest-server.ts` is +15 / -465: the 12-line stub, the new import plus its comment (2), and the 2-line pointer comment replacing the `strandedDecisionDetails` import (5 lines); one `};` line the diff keeps in place. `approvals-routes.ts` adds the module docblock, the imports, the `ApprovalsRouteHost` interface and its docblock, and the function docblock and signature.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (a gate's target paths; see the note at the end): `approvals-routes.ts` is discovered by the `*-routes.ts` convention and declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, as the two earlier modules are. `rest-server.ts` stringError 18 to 17 and siblingCode 31 to 22; the new module carries 1 and 9, both measured by the gate. Sums 17 + 13 + 8 + 1 = 39 and 22 + 15 + 8 + 9 = 54, unchanged. The gate's output differs from base only in those lines and the module counts (13 to 14 modules, 4 to 5 ratcheted).
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts`, the declaration half of `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` (also a gate target path): the `runtime-pinned` row for the template family `APPROVAL_*_FAILED` names `approvals-routes.ts` where it named `rest-server.ts`. Re-pointed, not re-judged: 57 sites, 57 classified, as at base. The file is not reachable from `@objectstack/runtime`'s entry, so nothing published moves.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`: the two anchors `rest-server.ts#flowMoveRoute` and `rest-server.ts#handleApprovalError` name `approvals-routes.ts`, where both declarations now live.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`: `rest-server.ts#mapping` resolved, at base, to the only `mapping` declaration in that file, which is `handleApprovalError`'s prefix map. It now names `approvals-routes.ts#mapping`, the same declaration. See the acceptance notes: that anchor's prose describes something the declaration never held.
  - `check:platform-checklist` output is identical base vs head for all three anchors (same per-family resolved counts, so no floor moves).
- `packages/rest/src/execctx-consumer-census.test.ts`: reads the list; 62 sites = 41 + 9 + 5 + 7, unchanged. Mentions 85 to 89: the four new ones are this slice's seam (forwarder, two; interface member, two). Three forwarders now, one per moved module, pinned as before (`SITE_FILES.length - 1`); the stack-frame pattern is built from the list.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`: the `rest-server.ts` row's population rule reads the list, so 70 / 19 / 51 is unchanged; the seven moved registration sites are still `RestServer`'s and still in the blind spot. `this.routeManager.register(` stays 63 (42 + 9 + 5 + 7), with one control per module (the new one 7) and `registrar list length` 4. `enforceAuth` 68 to 72, re-anchored: four seam occurrences, no call site added.
- `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` and `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts`: `REGISTRAR_SOURCES` is the list. Over it `this.enforceAuth(` reads 50 and `this.resolveExecCtx(` 65 (49 and 64 at base, +1 each for the forwarder); `this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership(` stays 1. Both pin the list's length.
- `rest-approvals-wire-codes.test.ts`: the header's present-tense pointer to the three route factories names `approvals-routes.ts`.

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the move in place and that reader not yet moved. The suites ran at `eaadafb41`, the move alone: the `rest` suite read `Tests 5 failed | 5840 passed | 326 skipped (6171)`, all five in `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` (62 sites read 55, 46 bare read 39 twice, and the two driven sweeps 40 against at least 46 and 26 against at least 30); the dogfood pair read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)`, population 63 against 70 and the control `this.routeManager.register(` 56 against 63.
- `check:route-envelope`: `approvals-routes.ts NOT DECLARED`, and `rest-server.ts` stringError 17 against 18, siblingCode 22 against 31.
- `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`: `[stale-row] ... 'APPROVAL_*_FAILED' at packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts (objlittemplate) but the scan no longer finds it`, and `[unclassified-site] packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`.
- `check:platform-checklist`: 11 problems against base's 8, the three ABSENT SYMBOL anchors above.
- ⚠️ The two `ui-view` readers would have stayed GREEN: their whole-file checks are floors (greater than 40), and without the list they read 43 and 58. That is the silent narrowing the list exists to close, and the reason they import it rather than staying as they were.

## Readers examined and not re-pointed

- `auth-gate-allowlist-fault-window.measurement.test.ts`, `execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability.test.ts`, runtime `meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: they slice other members of `rest-server.ts` (the gate block, `computeExecCtx`, `/meta`).
- core `authz-store-unavailable.test.ts`: it discovers transports by `resolveAuthzContext`, which the moved body does not call.
- The ADR anchor `packages__rest__src__rest-server.ts.json` (ADR-0045, `filterAppForUser`) is unaffected. `docs/adr/0076-...md` names `registerApprovalsEndpoints` as an example; the private method is still the registrar, so the pointer still lands.
- Gates with output identical base vs head (pre-merge reading at `60d82243b`): `check-durability-degradation-log-level`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-single-authz-resolver`, `check-rest-log-declared`, `check:liveness`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:rest-log-spy-declared`. Identical except the scanned-file counts (+2, the two new files): `check-meta-type-normalized`, `check-nul-bytes`, `check-adr-anchors`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-undeclared-dep-imports` (+1 specifier). `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` +4 file-level anchors (the new comments in `check-route-envelope.mjs`); `check-affected-docs` 21 to 22 route sources (the new module, admitted by the filename convention).
- No line citation in the repo points into the moved range (base :11869-:12348); the only `rest-server.ts:NNNNN` citation at or above :11000 is `:11108`, in a release-owned CHANGELOG.

## Acceptance notes

- **`packages/spec` prose, not edited (the claim keeps `packages/spec` out):** `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` names `rest-server.ts` as the home of the approvals route factories and `handleApprovalError` in three comments (about :199, :291 and :1274). They are `//` comments, read by no gate. They now describe code in `approvals-routes.ts`. Named in the report for the `domain:spec` seat.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`'s `#mapping` anchor (the OCC item, "CONCURRENT_UPDATE → 409 mapping") lands, at base and at head, on `handleApprovalError`'s prefix map, which holds no `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` row; `packages/rest/src` spells `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` only in one comment. The move keeps it landing where it landed. Re-judging which declaration that item should cite is not a move.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/record-reader-visibility.test.ts` (about :363) cites "`rest-server.ts` handleApprovalError" in a comment. Another lane's file, read by nothing; not edited.
- `scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs`'s header quotes a past `[stale-row]` message that names `rest-server.ts`. It is a quotation of output, not a pointer; not edited.
- `rest-approvals-wire-codes.test.ts` keeps one dated measurement sentence ("deleting the row from `rest-server.ts` reds THREE cases"), true when written; only its present-tense pointer was re-pointed.
- `docs/adr/0076-...md` D11 records the maintainer's 2026-08-15 ruling that `rest-server.ts` would be delineated, not split; the card's later direction (quoted on #23050) is what slices 1 to 3 execute. The ADR is a governed surface and is not edited here.
- Lines of `rest-server.ts` from about :42 to :318 shift by -3, from :322 to the moved block by -1, and after it by -450 (base :12351 is head :11901).
